start.subtitle.en: CDR reads it, checks every track against AccurateRip and files it into your library.
start.subtitle.zh-CN: CDR 会读取光盘，逐轨对照 AccurateRip 校验，然后存入你的曲库。

start.access_denied.en: CDR isn't allowed to read discs. Allow it in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Files & Folders › CDR › Removable Volumes.
start.access_denied.zh-CN: CDR 没有读取光盘的权限。请在「系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 文件与文件夹 › CDR › 可移除宗卷」中允许。

notice.auto_open_music.en: macOS opens the Music app when you insert a CD, and it reads the disc at the same time as CDR. In System Settings › CDs & DVDs, set “When you insert a music CD” to Ignore.
notice.auto_open_music.zh-CN: 插入 CD 时 macOS 会打开「音乐」App，它会和 CDR 同时读盘。请在「系统设置 › CD 与 DVD」中把「插入音乐 CD 时」设为「忽略」。

notice.auto_open_other.en: macOS opens another app when you insert a CD, and it reads the disc at the same time as CDR. In System Settings › CDs & DVDs, set “When you insert a music CD” to Ignore.
notice.auto_open_other.zh-CN: 插入 CD 时 macOS 会打开另一个 App，它会和 CDR 同时读盘。请在「系统设置 › CD 与 DVD」中把「插入音乐 CD 时」设为「忽略」。

verdict.perfect.zh-CN: %{total} 轨全部与 AccurateRip 一致

verdict.verified.en: %{accurate} of %{total} tracks match AccurateRip, the rest read the same twice
verdict.verified.zh-CN: %{total} 轨中 %{accurate} 轨与 AccurateRip 一致，其余两次读取一致

verdict.check.en: Reads didn't agree in places on tracks %{tracks}
verdict.check.zh-CN: 第 %{tracks} 轨部分位置读取不一致

library.none.zh-CN: 还没有选择曲库文件夹

settings.library_folder.hint.zh-CN: CDR 把每张专辑存到这里。

settings.file_names.hint.en: Uses {albumartist}, {artist}, {album}, {year}, {disc}, {discprefix}, {track} and {title}; / makes a folder. For example: %{example}
settings.file_names.hint.zh-CN: 可用 {albumartist}、{artist}、{album}、{year}、{disc}、{discprefix}、{track}、{title}；/ 表示文件夹。例如：%{example}

settings.reading.hint.en: Slower. Each track is read twice and compared, which matters for discs AccurateRip doesn't know.
settings.reading.hint.zh-CN: 较慢。每轨读两遍并比对，对 AccurateRip 没有收录的光盘更有用。

settings.offset.hint.en: In samples. Leave it empty and CDR finds your drive's offset from AccurateRip's list of drives or from the discs it rips.
settings.offset.hint.zh-CN: 单位为采样。留空时，CDR 会从 AccurateRip 的光驱列表或抓过的光盘中找出光驱的偏移。

settings.offset.invalid.en: Type a whole number of samples, like +6 or -1164, or leave it empty.
settings.offset.invalid.zh-CN: 请输入整数采样数，如 +6 或 -1164，或者留空。

settings.jellyfin.hint.en: The server's address. After each rip, Jellyfin scans its music libraries.
settings.jellyfin.hint.zh-CN: 服务器地址。每次抓取后，Jellyfin 会扫描它的音乐库。

settings.api_key.hint.en: Create one in Jellyfin under Dashboard › API Keys. Kept in your Keychain.
settings.api_key.hint.zh-CN: 在 Jellyfin 的「控制台 › API 密钥」中创建。保存在你的钥匙串里。

settings.api_key.not_saved.en: Couldn't save the key to the Keychain: %{error}
settings.api_key.not_saved.zh-CN: 无法把密钥存入钥匙串：%{error}

settings.jellyfin.incomplete.en: Enter the server's address and an API key first.
settings.jellyfin.incomplete.zh-CN: 请先填写服务器地址和 API 密钥。

rip.bad_offset.en: The read offset in Settings isn't a number of samples.
rip.bad_offset.zh-CN: 设置中的读取偏移不是有效的采样数。

jellyfin.failed.zh-CN: 已保存，但 Jellyfin 没有重新扫描：%{error}
